programme.desc: S1 E3 — The Godfather: JupiterProfessor Brian Cox visits a planet that dwarfs all the others: Jupiter. Its enormous size gives it a great power that it has used to manipulate the other planets. Jupiter is not only the biggest but also the oldest planet in the solar system. It alone witnessed the birth of the Sun and ever since its immense gravity has shaped the destiny of the other worlds.

programme.title: The Singing Detective
programme.desc: S1 E5 — Pitter PatterForty years on, one of Marlow's fellow patients comes to the end of his Philip Marlow book as the day's visitors flood into the ward. And just as he is falling into a doze, Marlow senses the presence of his scheming ex-wife.

programme.title: The Singing Detective
programme.desc: S1 E6 — Who Done ItThe young Philip Marlow returns to the country railway station following his mother's death in London. Forty years on, Marlow the hospital patient still dreams about the homecoming and the frightening figure of the scarecrow that now erupts into the ward.

programme.title: Timewatch
programme.desc: The Gunpowder PlotAn exploration of the attempt to blow up the Houses of Parliament in 1605, one of the most famous yet least understood events in British history. It shows how the plot was almost England's 9/11, and asks why a group of young Englishmen became so radicalised and so hell-bent on terrorism. Computer graphics recreate what the Houses of Parliament looked like in 1605, and show just how close the plotters came to success.

programme.title: Secrets of Skin
programme.desc: S1 E3 — ProtectionSkin is the external barrier between animals and the outside world, protecting vertebrates from extremes of temperature, the harmful effect of UV and a host of living organisms that want to get in.

programme.title: Gareth Edwards' Great Welsh Adventure
programme.desc: S2 E5 — BreconMaureen has arranged a trip the spectacular Brecon Beacons. But it's not the usual walks amid epic mountain scenery on the agenda. In a first for both, the childhood sweethearts enlist in tank school. After donning cam cream and military gear, the couple get a lesson in controlling a full-sized tank.

programme.desc: S1 E12 — PineappleLive from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the magical Pineapple attempting to perform a very difficult magic trick with the help of Kiwi.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: S1 E18 — Say GoodbyeBing and Sula are having so much fun playing together they don't want to say goodbye when Amma arrives to pick Sula up. To delay her departure Bing hides Sula's sparkly shoe in the toilet, and it gets soaking wet much to Sula's annoyance. It looks as though Sula will have to hop home until Bing finds a way to turn the badbye back into a goodbye again.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: S1 E5 — BabiesThe Teletubbies eat tubby custard and ride the Custard Train around Home Dome. A child in Tummy Tales tries to make his baby sister laugh.

programme.title: Tee and Mo
programme.desc: S1 E30 — Tent KiteA trip to the park is the perfect opportunity for Tee to fly his kite and for Mo to try out her new pop-up tent. However, kite flying and tent popping can be trickier than they seem.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: S1 E6 — GreenGreen arrives, bringing her natural colour to Colourland. Learn about the colour green.

programme.title: Bluey Minisodes
programme.desc: S3 E6 — AlongsideBluey and Honey go about their separate days until luck brings them together momentarily.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: S2 E20 — Charlie Did ItBing is teaching Charlie how to throw, but when he throws the ball in the lounge it knocks the fruit over! Bing starts to explain, but Charlie interrupts, leaving Flop to believe Charlie did it. Happily, Bing shows Charlie how to voosh Squeaky instead, but it flies out of his hands and hits Flop's tray of snacks! After some encouragement, Bing tells Flop the truth and apologises.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: S1 E8 — Watch the BirdiePreston needs Mojo and Bo to pull his big balloon to a place where he can snap a picture of a rare bird. But his balloon gets loose, and Mojo and Bo need to get Preston back on the ground.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S4 E3 — Roly's First DayAs Roly makes his usual noise in the Clubhouse, Duggee and the Squirrels reminisce about how completely different Roly was when he first arrived. Hiding behind his dad, Roly wasn't loud at all but impossibly quiet. As Duggee shows Roly around the Clubhouse, he squeals, hides and hangs off his dad, and just seems altogether too shy to fit in. Duggee has a great idea to introduce Roly to Norrie, thinking a friend will help him to settle in.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S4 E4 — Spot the DifferenceNext, the Squirrels watch the bugs on the tree and put on a play to catch the differences. The Squirrels watch the play, but when they watch it again, the bugs are different. They are now a banana and a clown. The Squirrels see it right away as they are getting better. Now it's time to play ultimate spot the difference. The Squirrels go outside the Clubhouse with Duggee and watch all the animals take formation. We see a complete match on the right and left sides.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S3 E43 — DragonWhen Bluey needs some assistance drawing a dragon for a story she is working on, she asks her dad, Bandit, for help.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S2 E28 — SeesawDad has rudely plonked himself on one end of the seesaw. So Bluey and Bingo round up the entire playground to help flip him off, but they still need to find one more friend.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: S3 E25 — Go Jet Academy: Whale RescueAfter a pod of pilot whales becomes stranded at the Academy beach, the Go Jetters, with help from new teacher Professor Wave, must work fast to return them to the ocean deeps. But with Glitch's camouflaged submarine zooming around the nearby waters, the situation quickly becomes more complicated.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: S2 — The Tale of Old RustyPeter and friends venture to Rocky Island to find the mysterious Old Rusty mentioned in Peter's father's journal.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: S2 E25 — Sand CatRising seas send Calico Jack and Kwazii on a hunt, where they encounter a sand cat.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: S7 E9 — Sail the Seven SeasJoin the Seven Times Table as he sails the seven seas in search of the rainbow's end. The Seven Times Table is a jolly friend, who brings good luck. He's very clever, and with Sevens he never gets stuck. He collects his crew as he sings his Seven Times sea shanty.

programme.title: Wonderblocks
programme.desc: S1 E9 — Moo! Cluck! Baa!Cow, Sheep and Secret Agent Chicken take part in a musical contest.

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: S2 E13 — Challenge Yourself DayLove Monster is excited to start a Challenge Yourself Day adventure with his friends. He's planned a mountain hike with a special sunset surprise for them at the peak.

programme.title: Justin's House
programme.desc: S5 E4 — In the DoghouseJustin and Robert look after three dogs for a day, but Robert isn't happy when Justin's House becomes the messiest it has ever been.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Being KindDuggee is a big, friendly dog who runs The Squirrel Club, an after-school activity club where children can learn and take part in all kinds of activities, have fun adventures, and earn badges for their achievements.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: S2 E3 — Face PaintSula and Amma surprise Bing to show him Sula's sparkly painted butterfly face. Bing also wants a painted face, one that looks like Biteysaurus, and Sula says she can do it for him. Sula begins smothering his face in Bitey's signature green, but when she accidentally adds purple spots, Bing is horrified! He wants Sula to go home. But then Flop adds some teeth to Bing's Biteysaurus, so he can really be Bitey.

programme.title: Yakka Dee
programme.desc: S2 E7 — BirdDee encourages a friend to say 'bird' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different birds, from small birds to big birds, flying birds to swimming birds. There's a pecking bird, a magnificent bird, a napping bird and even a rapping bird! Look out for the feathery bird, the flying bird and also some little tweeting birds in a nest.

programme.title: Tralala
programme.desc: S1 E16 — Ice CreamologyTralala is obsessed with ice cream and will stop at nothing to get it.

programme.title: MaeBee
programme.desc: S1 E9 — Mae, Bee and the Lost Lost HatWhen hiding inside an old gnome's hat, Mae and Bee make a surprise discovery amongst the junk!

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: S1 E20 — The PalorcheciesKiri is sad when Lou goes away to a private meeting of his species, the Palorchecies. So she decides to follow him.

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: S2 E16 — Next ToThe Twirlywoos see a lady putting coloured stars next to items in a shop window display, and getting carried away putting stars next to everything in sight. The Stop-Go Car brings some blocks, and the Twirlywoos have fun lining them up.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: S11 E7 — We're All Friends: Star ChartJustin is in for a surprise when he meets two Irish dancing stars who set him a challenge. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble is trying to earn a star for his star chart by washing Lord Tumble's car.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: S2 E26 — This Way That WayThe Teletubbies go 'this way, that way' on a Tubby Car journey to the Hidey Hup. The Tubby Spinny goes 'this way, that way' too.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: S2 E2 — Toy TransportNigel and Baby Bear welcome babies Evie, Gracie, Luke, Hunter, Thea, Benjamin and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Inside everyone's bags are different types of toy transport which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding safe, baby appropriate toy vehicles inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby!

programme.title: The Jungle Book
programme.desc: A boy is raised by animals in the jungles of India, but his carefree life is threatened by the return of a fierce tiger with a grudge against humans. The youngster faces a difficult choice between remaining with his friends or returning to his own people. Live action remake of Disney's animated adventure based on Rudyard Kipling's stories, starring Neel Sethi, with the voices of Bill Murray, Ben Kingsley and Idris Elba.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian
programme.desc: The four Pevensie children are summoned back to the magical land of Narnia to find centuries have passed in their absence. War is now brewing, and the young heroes must help Prince Caspian, the rightful king of Narnia, to overthrow his cruel uncle and reclaim the throne. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Ben Barnes, William Moseley, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell and Peter Dinklage.

programme.title: Frankenweenie
programme.desc: A lonely boy uses electricity to bring his dead dog back to life. However, the presence of the animal in the neighbourhood leads to panic over a monster, while the young scientist's classmates are soon also meddling with life and death to revive their own pets. Tim Burton's stop-motion animated fantasy, with the voices of Charlie Tahan and Winona Ryder.

programme.title: National Treasure: Book of Secrets
programme.desc: Intrepid archaeologist Ben Gates sets out to clear the family name when evidence emerges that an ancestor was involved in the assassination of Abraham Lincoln. His mission leads him on another globe-trotting treasure hunt that uncovers a secret conspiracy. Adventure sequel, starring Nicolas Cage, Helen Mirren, Ed Harris, Harvey Keitel and Jon Voight.

programme.title: Wish
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Asha makes a wish on a star to save her kingdom from rising evil and her plea is answered by a celestial body with the power to grant further desires. Animated fantasy featuring the voice of Arianna DeBose.

programme.title: Inspector Gadget
programme.desc: A clumsy security guard is critically injured during a run-in with a thief, so his cybernetics-expert employer transforms him into the ultimate crime-fighting machine - a bionic officer with an array of gadgets and weaponry cunningly concealed inside his body. Comedy adventure based on the 1980s cartoon series, starring Matthew Broderick, Rupert Everett and Joely Fisher.

programme.title: Solo: A Star Wars Story
programme.desc: Amid emerging demand for hyperfuel and other resources, a headstrong pilot gets mixed up with a bunch of mercenaries, a militant robot, a gambler and a Wookie while attempting to appease a crime lord in an adventure that exposes an underworld's seedy belly. Sci-fi prequel set before the events of Star Wars: A New Hope, starring Alden Ehrenreich, Emilia Clarke, Woody Harrelson, Donald Glover and Paul Bettany.

programme.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol 2
programme.desc: After saving Xandar from Ronan's wrath, intergalactic outlaws Peter Quill (AKA Star-Lord), Gamora, Drax the Destroyer, Groot and Rocket Raccoon are recognised as heroes. Now, they must fight to stay together as they unravel the mystery surrounding Ego, a man who claims to be Quill's father. Writer/director James Gunn's follow up to his 2014 blockbuster, which reunites Chris Pratt, Zoe Saldana, Karen Gillan and Dave Bautista, with support from Kurt Russell, Sylvester Stallone and Pom Klementieff. Bradley Cooper also provides the voice of Rocket and Vin Diesel is Groot.

programme.title: Alien: Covenant
programme.desc: A crew of colonists sent to populate an alien planet have their mission diverted by a mysterious signal. After landing on a nearby world, they discover what became of the ill-fated Prometheus mission. Ridley Scott's sci-fi thriller, starring Katherine Waterston, Michael Fassbender and Danny McBride.

programme.title: Death on the Nile
programme.desc: Belgian sleuth Hercule Poirot attempts to solve a murder while on a luxury cruise down the famous Egyptian river. Mystery, based on the Agatha Christie novel, directed by and starring Kenneth Branagh, with Gal Gadot, Annette Bening and Armie Hammer.

programme.title: The Aristocats
programme.desc: A jealous butler is outraged when his employer leaves a vast fortune to her cat and kittens instead of to him, so he drives the pets to the French countryside and dumps them. However, a streetwise alley cat steps in to help the pampered felines find their way home and claim their rightful inheritance. Animated adventure, with the voices of Eva Gabor, Phil Harris and Scatman Crothers.

programme.title: Cinderella
programme.desc: An orphan is forced to live a life of servitude by her cruel stepmother. The king of the realm she lives in organises a lavish ball to find a bride for his son, and a caring fairy godmother puts her magic to the task of turning the downtrodden girl into a princess. Animated fairytale, with the voices of Ilene Woods, William Phipps and Verna Felton.

programme.title: Frankenweenie
programme.desc: A lonely boy uses electricity to bring his dead dog back to life. However, the presence of the animal in the neighbourhood leads to panic over a monster, while the young scientist's classmates are soon also meddling with life and death to revive their own pets. Tim Burton's stop-motion animated fantasy, with the voices of Charlie Tahan and Winona Ryder.

programme.title: Percy Jackson & the Lightning Thief
programme.desc: A teenager is shocked to discover he is the son of Greek god Poseidon and has been accused of stealing Zeus's lightning bolt. The youngster is given 14 days to find the culprit and return the missing item before the furious deity instigates an apocalyptic war. Fantasy adventure, starring Logan Lerman, Pierce Brosnan, Brandon T Jackson, Alexandra Daddario, Jake Abel, Sean Bean and Steve Coogan.

programme.title: Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas
programme.desc: Jack Skellington, the Pumpkin King of Halloween Town, tires of being scary and decides to take over the friendly world of Christmas. After kidnapping Santa, he prepares to take his place and do Christmas in his own ghoulish way. Stop-motion animated fantasy, with the voices of Chris Sarandon, Catherine O'Hara and Paul Reubens, and a musical score by Danny Elfman.

programme.title: The Good Dinosaur
programme.desc: In a world where the asteroid impact that wiped out the dinosaurs never happened, humans have evolved as a primitive species while the giant lizards remain the dominant life form on Earth. A young apatosaurus becomes separated from his family, but finds a friend in a feral human boy as he makes the dangerous journey home. Pixar animated adventure, with the voices of Raymond Ochoa and Jack Bright.

programme.title: Mary Poppins Returns
programme.desc: In 1930s London, Michael Banks lives in his family home with his children, Annabel, John, and Georgie. Still grieving the death of his wife, and behind on loan payments, his house is due to be repossessed unless he comes up with the money soon. Thankfully, help comes in the form of the practically perfect nanny who returns 25 years after her previous visit. Musical fantasy, starring Emily Blunt, Dick Van Dyke and Meryl Streep.

programme.title: Elio
programme.desc: Elio, a misfit kid, is mistaken for Earth's ambassador in space and bonds with aliens while discovering his true self. Pixar animation, with the voice of Yonas Kibreab.

programme.title: National Treasure: Book of Secrets
programme.desc: Intrepid archaeologist Ben Gates sets out to clear the family name when evidence emerges that an ancestor was involved in the assassination of Abraham Lincoln. His mission leads him on another globe-trotting treasure hunt that uncovers a secret conspiracy. Adventure sequel, starring Nicolas Cage, Helen Mirren, Ed Harris, Harvey Keitel and Jon Voight.

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: The struggling owner of a run-down gym is forced to take drastic action to prevent an arrogant fitness guru buying the business out from under him - and enlists his customers to form a dodgeball team in the hope of triumphing in the US championships. Sporting comedy, starring Ben Stiller, Vince Vaughn and Christine Taylor.

programme.title: Logan
programme.desc: In the near future, Wolverine cares for an ailing Professor X somewhere on the Mexican border. However, the razor-clawed hero's attempts to hide from the world are turned upside down when a young mutant arrives, pursued by cyborg bounty hunters in the employ of a sinister corporation. Fantasy adventure, starring Hugh Jackman, Patrick Stewart, Dafne Keen and Stephen Merchant. Directed by James Mangold (Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny).

programme.title: The Omen
programme.desc: A US ambassador who adopted his son in suspicious circumstances is troubled by the child's increasingly disturbing behaviour. A priest contacts him and claims the boy is the offspring of the Devil, but the father refuses to believe it - until a spate of deaths convinces him otherwise. Remake of the 1976 horror classic, starring Liev Schreiber, Julia Stiles, Seamus Davey-Fitzpatrick and Pete Postlethwaite.

programme.title: Spy
programme.desc: A deskbound CIA agent provides valuable background support for a dashing secret agent, but has never gone into action herself. Everything changes, when the spy mysteriously vanishes, and she leaps into action to take his place, infiltrating the inner circle of a ruthless arms dealer and trying to avert a global catastrophe. Comedy adventure, starring Melissa McCarthy, Jason Statham and Rose Byrne.

programme.title: Young Woman and the Sea
programme.desc: Through the steadfast support of her older sister and supportive trainers, Trudy Ederle overcomes adversity to rise through the ranks of the Olympic swimming team. She then attempts to become the first woman to successfully swim the English Channel. Drama, starring Daisy Ridley and Stephen Graham.

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: A young deer grows up in the forest, forming close friendships with other woodland creatures. When tragedy strikes, he is suddenly forced to fend for himself but ultimately becomes brave and resourceful enough to save his friends during a forest fire. Animated drama, with the voices of Bobby Stewart, Hardie Albright and Donnie Dunagan.

programme.title: Wish
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Asha makes a wish on a star to save her kingdom from rising evil and her plea is answered by a celestial body with the power to grant further desires. Animated fantasy featuring the voice of Arianna DeBose.

programme.title: Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas
programme.desc: Jack Skellington, the Pumpkin King of Halloween Town, tires of being scary and decides to take over the friendly world of Christmas. After kidnapping Santa, he prepares to take his place and do Christmas in his own ghoulish way. Stop-motion animated fantasy, with the voices of Chris Sarandon, Catherine O'Hara and Paul Reubens, and a musical score by Danny Elfman.

programme.title: Brave
programme.desc: A princess defies her mother's plans to secure peace by marrying her off to the son of one of their allies. A witch provides the rebellious royal with a magic spell to change her fate, but the enchantment backfires disastrously when the queen is transformed into a bear. Pixar's animated fantasy, with the voices of Kelly Macdonald, Emma Thompson and Billy Connolly.

programme.title: Frankenweenie
programme.desc: A lonely boy uses electricity to bring his dead dog back to life. However, the presence of the animal in the neighbourhood leads to panic over a monster, while the young scientist's classmates are soon also meddling with life and death to revive their own pets. Tim Burton's stop-motion animated fantasy, with the voices of Charlie Tahan and Winona Ryder.

programme.title: Elio
programme.desc: Elio, a misfit kid, is mistaken for Earth's ambassador in space and bonds with aliens while discovering his true self. Pixar animation, with the voice of Yonas Kibreab.

programme.title: Mary Poppins Returns
programme.desc: In 1930s London, Michael Banks lives in his family home with his children, Annabel, John, and Georgie. Still grieving the death of his wife, and behind on loan payments, his house is due to be repossessed unless he comes up with the money soon. Thankfully, help comes in the form of the practically perfect nanny who returns 25 years after her previous visit. Musical fantasy, starring Emily Blunt, Dick Van Dyke and Meryl Streep.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian
programme.desc: The four Pevensie children are summoned back to the magical land of Narnia to find centuries have passed in their absence. War is now brewing, and the young heroes must help Prince Caspian, the rightful king of Narnia, to overthrow his cruel uncle and reclaim the throne. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Ben Barnes, William Moseley, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell and Peter Dinklage.

programme.title: The Maze Runner
programme.desc: A teen arrives in an isolated community of youngsters, with no memory of who he is or the outside world. When another new arrival brings an ominous message, he realises time is running out for the group and they must find an escape route through a deadly labyrinth if they are to survive. Sci-fi adventure based on James Dashner's novel, starring Dylan O'Brien, Kaya Scodelario and Patricia Clarkson.

programme.title: Tron: Legacy
programme.desc: Ground-breaking computer genius Kevin Flynn disappears without trace. Years later, his son Sam goes looking for him, and is transported into a computer-generated world where he is forced to compete in deadly gladiatorial combat by an evil duplicate of his father plotting to wage war on the real world. Sci-fi adventure, with Jeff Bridges and Garrett Hedlund.

programme.title: The Heat
programme.desc: An uptight, ambitious FBI agent is sent to Boston to bring a notorious drug kingpin to justice. She ends up forced to team up with a rebellious, foul-mouthed local police detective who has a very different attitude to law enforcement but shares her inability to work with others. Action comedy, starring Sandra Bullock and Melissa McCarthy.

programme.title: The Proposal
programme.desc: A Canadian publishing editor working in New York faces deportation to her own country. Desperate to stay in America, she offers her assistant a promotion if he will marry her, but an immigration official becomes suspicious and the pair are forced to go to desperate lengths to look like a happy couple. Romantic comedy, starring Sandra Bullock and Ryan Reynolds.

programme.title: Young Woman and the Sea

Fantasy adventure, starring Logan Lerman, Pierce Brosnan, Brandon T Jackson, Alexandra Daddario, Jake Abel, Sean Bean and Steve Coogan.

programme.desc: S3 E5 — Liverpool v ChelseaLiverpool v Chelsea (Kick-off 8.00pm). programme.title: Evidence of the Unexplained
programme.desc: S1 E6 — Episode 6A fleet of UFOs is filmed over the South China Sea, a 12,000-year-old archaeological site reveals carvings of alien, six-fingered humanoids, and a recorded confession claims that Albert Einstein made a secret visit to Roswell in 1947 to see a crashed UFO and its dead and dying occupants.

programme.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
programme.desc: S4 E5 — The Shoot Down OrderFighter pilots scramble to intercept UFOs. Advanced, unknown technology threatens Earth's airspace, and there is little anyone can do about it.

programme.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
programme.desc: S4 E6 — Seeing Is BelievingGovernments around the world investigate UFO sightings, but many of them keep it a secret from the public.

programme.title: Alien Files Reopened
programme.desc: S1 E7 — The Belgian UFO WaveTriangle shaped hovering objects were seen by thousands of people and investigated by scientists and government officials, yet they could never be explained. The sightings occurred in a more than two year "wave" over Belgium, beginning in late 1989.

programme.title: UFOs: The Lost Evidence
programme.desc: S1 E6 — Deathbed ConfessionsUFO researchers believe NASA is hiding the truth about alien life. Could the deathbed confessions of famous scientists reveal a history of otherworldly contact?

programme.title: Close Encounters
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Big Woods, Bright LightsCousins Billy and John Smith encounter a massive ship triple the size of a football stadium, and guards at Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana spot an unidentified object overhead.

programme.title: Close Encounters
programme.desc: S2 E2 — War of the WorldsLaura Sinclair is walking her dog when she sees a large cylindrical object hovering in the sky. Plus, school children in Florida witness multiple UFO sightings.

programme.title: Bone Detectives: Britain's Buried Secrets
programme.desc: S2 E3 — Norton Priory, CheshireTucked away in a Runcorn industrial park is the most excavated monastic site in Europe, revealing a story of medieval knights, brutal murder and ancient disease.

programme.title: Myths & Monsters
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Heroes and VillainsRevealing the strange Slavic story of Ivan and Koschei the Deathless, the origins of King Arthur and the wizard Merlin, the journey of Odysseus as he resists the beautiful song of the Sirens, and finally Sigurd and his battle with the dragon Fafnir.

programme.title: What on Earth?
programme.desc: S7 E20 — Episode 20Discover the lair of the living god and the Super Warrior of the ancient world, along with the riches and bloodshed in the California deserts.

programme.title: Mysteries From Above
programme.desc: S2 E10 — Ancient CivilizationsAn analysis of the secrets of long-lost human settlements, a mysterious Norwegian mound, pre-historic stone circle on the banks of the Tagus River, a lost city in the cradle of civilization and more.

programme.title: Mystery Places
programme.desc: S1 E20 — Episode 20Travel to Abu Dhabi's incredible Masdar City, check out the Wieliczka Salt Mine in Poland, and visit an Indian village where the houses don't have doors.

programme.title: William Shatner's Weird or What?

programme.desc: E4The Russian soldier who led a desperate outbreak from a secret Nazi death camp, Operation Chicken - an audacious plan to flee an escape-proof Japanese prison camp, and the pilots whose bold bid for freedom won the admiration of their enemies.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E3The definitive, if not the best, Axis fighter of World War two: we delve into the story of legendary ace Adolf Galland and examine in detail and example of the type in his colours. We also look at the technical heritage the 109 designers left.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E4The story of the prolonged development and the initially troubled operational history of the Boeing B-29 Superfortress. Forever known as the airframe that dropped the first atomic weapons on Japan, the B-29 lived on well beyond its war years.

programme.title: Greatest Escapes of WWII
programme.desc: E1Colditz Castle, the foreboding Nazi fortress that became a university of escapology; The Great Escape, and the doomed airmen of Stalag Luft Three; and the most daring breakout of them all, the ‘Warburg Wire Job’.

programme.title: Greatest Escapes of WWII
programme.desc: E2An adrenaline-fuelled dash through nazi-occupied Europe known as ‘The Flight of the Crow’, a death-defying escape across the world’s most perilous mountain range, and the largest escape of world war two - by men who chose death over dishonour.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E1The Avro Lancaster is the legendary British heavy bomber that carved its place in history with Bomber Command during World War 2. That conflict saw over seven thousand of these iconic aircraft come off the production line.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E2Unusually, we look at the later, clipped wing version flown by Czech refugee pilots in the UK during WW2. We get close-up with a beautifully restored example, fly her and unearth long unseen test and operational footage.

programme.title: Hitler's Engineers
programme.desc: E3Werner Heisenberg is one of the most controversial scientists of the Third Reich. A key figure in the Nazis’ efforts to build an atomic bomb, the target of an Allied assassination plot.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E8The Leopard 2 is probably the best all-around Main Battle Tank today, combining great mobility, a superior gun and excellent protection.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E6New weapons with devastating force shape the wars of the 20th century. International experts test the catastrophic effects of the three most destructive weapons of our time: the machine gun, hand grenade and tank.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E5In spectacular experiments, a team of international experts presents the most significant cases in the history of weapons where speed has made a decisive difference.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E3The Republic P-47 Thunderbolt, a Second World War fighter aircraft produced by the American company Republic Aviation from 1941 until 1945. It was considered a successful high-altitude fighter and also served as the foremost US fighter-bomber in the ground-attack role.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E4The Yakovlev Yak-3, a Second World War Soviet fighter that was regarded for its performance at low altitudes and its agility. It was one of the most successful Soviet aircraft designs of the war.

programme.title: Hitler's Engineers
programme.desc: E6Fritz Todt was Hitler’s leading engineer and his Minister of Armaments. He was the man the Führer tasked with the most demanding engineering projects.

programme.title: Hitler's Engineers
programme.desc: E5In Porsche, Hitler found a talented designer capable of leading Germany to new heights on the racetrack, while also helping rally the support of the masses at home.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E1In the north of Crete, six commandos land in a cove. On this island that has been occupied for two years, they have been given a high-risk mission—to infiltrate the Heraklion airfield to destroy the Luftwaffe bombers and fighter planes.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E2December 7th, 1942. Off the coast of France, ten British commandos board five canoes in the middle of the ocean. Their objective: to paddle to the Gironde estuary, then up the river to Bordeaux to sabotage German ships.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E7A look at key maritime weapons such as the secret super-weapon that kept Constantinople safe for centuries, the thunderous force of a ship's cannon, and the deadly torpedo.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E8Examining how the techniques of ambush, along with weapons that remained undetected until the very moment they were used, would revolutionise warfare.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E1The F15 Eagle immediately turned the tide of the first Gulf War to prove its greatness. Our immaculately restored MiG Killer was involved in one of the most bizarre combat incidents during that conflict, and has survived to tell the tale.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E2The mighty Flying Fortress takes to the air as we examine the background and development of one of WWIIs most iconic bombers. Serving with both the USAAF and the RAF, we see it in action and fly a surfing example.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E3On September 15th, 1942, 12 commandos reached Northern Norway. Their mission: to sabotage a hydroelectric plant crucial to the German war industry. To avoid detection, they decided to cross a huge high-altitude glacier.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E4In the midst of the reconquest of Italy, the Allies came up against the Winter Line—an impregnable line of defence built on the crests of a mountain range. They decided to call in a very special commando unit, the First Special Service Force.

programme.title: Secret Sex Lives Of Tyrants
programme.desc: E3Uncover Goebbels' public devotion and private hypocrisy, revealing how obsession, control and propaganda shaped power in Nazi Germany.

programme.title: Secret Sex Lives Of Tyrants

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E5The Hawker Hurricane was the first RAF aircraft to fly over 300mph. Over half of every enemy aeroplane destroyed in the Battle of Britain was by a Hurricane, not a Spitfire.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
